channel.title: Hypernode incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Hypernode's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: DNS Service (*.hypernode.io) is showing degraded performance [resolved]
Degraded performance when applying changes to Hypernodes [resolved]
Investigating: DNS Resolution Issues Affecting *.hypernode.io [resolved]
item.description:
The earlier DNS resolution instability affecting the *.hypernode.io domain has now fully recovered.
Stability has been restored and we are no longer observing any degraded performance or resolution failures over an extended period of time.

item.title: Degraded performance on our cloud provider location R405 [resolved]
item.description: Since implementing these measures and closely monitoring the situation, we have not observed any further downtime or service disruptions.

item.title: Partial service disruption for Brancher, Xgrade, and order processes. [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. A fix was successfully implemented, and we are continuing to monitor the results to ensure stability.

item.title: Control Panel Performance Degradation [resolved]
item.description: Issues has been fixed we don't expect this to occur again

item.title: Degraded reachability with Object Storage [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved by our Object Storage service provider.

item.title: Brief Network Instability in Datacenter [resolved]
item.description:
We experienced a brief network hiccup in one of our datacenters, which may have caused intermittent connectivity issues for approximately 15 minutes.
The issue has been resolved, and network stability has been fully restored. Our team monitored the situation closely to ensure no further impact.
No further action is required at this time. We will continue to monitor the platform to ensure ongoing stability.

item.title: Control Panel (my.hypernode.com) – Degraded Functionality [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting the "My Hypernodes” page has been isolated and resolved. All services are now operating normally.

item.title: Control Panel (my.hypernode.com) Not Loading Hypernodes [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting the control panel on my.hypernode.com, where the “My Hypernodes” page was not loading correctly, has been resolved.
All functionality is operating normally again, and no other services were impacted. We will continue to monitor the platform to ensure stability.

item.title: Identified Issue – Impact from Cloudflare Outage [resolved]
item.description: Cloudflare has resolved the underlying issue, and all our services are fully operational again. We have confirmed that both our Support systems and phone availability are functioning normally.

item.title: Cloudflare - Internal server error [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been marked as resolved by Cloudflare and we're expecting no more inconvenience.

item.title: Problems with resolving .hypernode.io [resolved]
item.description: Our DNS infrastructure has been running stable for the past 12 hours. We'll continue to monitor and improve the infrastructure.

item.title: Degraded performance [resolved]
item.description: We're seeing no current problems on the datacenter/Hypernode side, and it appears to be an instability with Cloudflare. Please be advised to consider disabling the proxy temporarily and monitoring the situation closely.

item.title: Cloud platform is experiencing degraded performance [resolved]
item.description:
All affected nodes have fully resumed operations.
Earlier, our cloud provider in Room R405 experienced a temporary issue with their network-storage layer, which caused downtime on these nodes. The provider quickly diagnosed and resolved the problem. We confirm that no data loss occurred.

item.title: Issue at the Cloud datacenter [resolved]
item.description: A brief network interruption in one of our OpenStack availability zones caused some instances to automatically reboot. The issue has been resolved and platform stability has been restored.

item.title: DNS Issues Due to DDoS Attack [resolved]
item.description: The issue has now been fully resolved, and all services are operating normally.
